source_text:
Τότε δὲ ὁ πιὼν ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος οὗ δώσει ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἕξει τὴν γενομένην ἐν αὐτῷ πηγὴν ὕδατος ἁλλομένου εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, ὅτε πληροῦται τοῦ μακαριζομένου ἐπὶ τῷ πεινῆν καὶ διψῆν τὴν δικαιοσύνην ἡ ἐπαγγελία. φησὶ γὰρ ὁ λόγος· Μακάριοι οἱ πεινῶντες καὶ διψῶντες τὴν δικαιοσύνην, ὅτι αὐτοὶ χορτασθήσονται.

καὶ τάχα ἐπεὶ πεινῆσαι καὶ διψῆσαι δεήσει τὴν δικαιοσύνην πρὸ τοῦ χορτασθῆναι, ὑπὲρ τοῦ κορεσθῆναι ἐμποιητέον τὸ πεινῆν καὶ τὸ διψῆν, ἵνα εἴπωμεν· Ὃν τρόπον ἐπιποθεῖ ἡ ἔλαφος ἐπὶ τὰς πηγὰς τῶν ὑδάτων, οὕτως ἐπιποθεῖ ἡ ψυχή μου πρὸς σέ, ὁ θεός.
pass_a_gloss: Then the one having drunk from the water which Jesus will give will have the spring of water leaping into eternal life that has come to be in him, when the promise of the one being beatified upon hungering and thirsting for righteousness is fulfilled. For the word says: Blessed are those hungering and thirsting for righteousness, for they themselves will be filled. And perhaps since it will be necessary to hunger and thirst for righteousness before being filled, for the sake of being satiated one must produce the hungering and the thirsting, in order that we may say: In the manner the deer longs upon the springs of the waters, so my soul longs toward you, O God.
pass_b_english: The one who drinks the water Jesus will give will have within him that [[spring of water leaping up to eternal life >> Bible:John 4:14]] when the promise spoken over those who hunger and thirst for righteousness is filled out. For the Word says, [[“Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.” >> Bible:Matthew 5:6]]

And perhaps, because one must hunger and thirst for righteousness before being filled, we have to let hunger and thirst be formed in us if we are to be satisfied — so that we may say, [[“As the deer longs for the springs of water, so my soul longs for you, O God.” >> Bible:Psalm 42:1]]
